# General questions

- Is your cognitive labour being affected by using a GenAI chatbot (or any AI tool)? [adapted from @guestsuarezrooij2025]
- Do you learn what you are supposed to learn?
- Can the use of AI be justified given the ethical and environmental concerns of AI tools?
- What exactly do you expect to gain by using GenAI chatbot (or any AI tool)? Could the task me carried out using other means? 





- for the use of AI in coding and learning how to code, see [Chapter 15](https://elenlefoll.github.io/RstatsTextbook/15_AI.html) in @lefoll
